hero.trustLine: 20+ years of guiding · Sri Lanka Tourism Board certified guides

home.introBody: Some of this island only shows itself to people who know where to wait. Leopard tracks in the dust at Wilpattu. An endemic bird calling somewhere in the Sinharaja canopy. Mist lifting off Horton Plains at seven in the morning. We travel with you for all of it — our own certified guides, with your accommodation and transport arranged from the first message to the last morning.

home.guideBody: Nandana began in wildlife conservation in 1990, qualified as a national guide in 2002, and founded Nature Walks Sri Lanka in 2017. He still leads tours himself.

nandana.introTitle: A lifetime spent walking through Sri Lanka.
nandana.whyTitle: Travel Sri Lanka with people who know it.

whyPoints.title: People who know the island
whyPoints.description: Our guides do more than take you from one place to another. They know the forests, wildlife, birds, seasons and local communities through years of being in the field.

whyPoints.title: One team, from beginning to end
whyPoints.description: Your guide, transport, accommodation and daily plans work together as one journey. You are not passed from one company to another.

whyPoints.title: Your journey, your way
whyPoints.description: Some travellers want wildlife from sunrise to sunset. Others want a little wildlife, some culture, time in the mountains and a few quiet days by the sea. We shape the journey around what you want to experience.

nandana.whyIntro: A good journey is about more than the places you visit. It is about who takes you there, what you notice along the way, and how naturally everything comes together.

sriLanka.title: Rainforest, highland and coast — closer together than you'd expect.
sriLanka.body: From Wilpattu's dry-zone leopard country to Sinharaja's endemic-rich rainforest canopy, from Kandy's hill temples to the reef off Trincomalee, Sri Lanka compresses a continent's worth of habitat into a single island.

conservation.title: Guiding rooted in fieldwork, not just hospitality.
conservation.quote: Nandana began his career with Sri Lanka's Department of Wildlife Conservation and remains a member of the Field Ornithology Group of the University of Colombo — conservation isn't a footnote to our tours, it's where the guiding started.
